name: University of Canterbury
description: The University of Canterbury is a public research university in Christchurch, established in 1873 as Canterbury College. It has about 20,800 students across six faculties including engineering, science and business.
whyIncluded: UC offers articulation pathways for engineering diploma holders from Singapore's five polytechnics into its Bachelor of Engineering (Hons), and New Zealand is among the ten destinations with the most Singaporean students abroad (about 360 in the UNESCO Institute for Statistics (UIS; UNESCO is the United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization) data for 2022-24).

livingCosts.notes: UC 'Flatting - estimate of costs' (page dated 15 July 2026; single person sharing a 4-bedroom house in Ilam), weekly x 52/12. Housing: rent $200 + power $20 + internet $8/wk. Food: $145/wk. Transport: $25/wk. Personal: mobile phone $8 + contents and liability insurance $10 + other/incidentals $20/wk. UC's weekly total is $436. Excludes one-off and annual extras (bond $800, rent in advance $400, furnishings $750, books $750, parking $560, clothing $750). UC's halls estimate is $525/wk.
